## What's Changed
* Update DiskInfoToolkit. by @Blacktempel in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2141
* GA-A320M Add missing controls by @Rem0o in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2157
* Feature/arctic fan controller by @Rem0o in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2152
* Bump System.IO.Ports from 10.0.1 to 10.0.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2158
* Bump System.Management from 10.0.1 to 10.0.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2160
* Bump System.Threading.AccessControl from 10.0.1 to 10.0.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2161
* Bump System.Text.Json from 10.0.1 to 10.0.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2163
* Bump System.Resources.Extensions from 10.0.1 to 10.0.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2162
* B850 GAMING PLUS WIFI6E (MS-7E80) by @Rem0o in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2164

* Bump Microsoft.Windows.CsWin32 from 0.3.264 to 0.3.269 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2165
* [UI] Fixes for Node expansion by @Blacktempel in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2173
* Update PawnIO modules to 2.2 by @Rem0o in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2174
* Add core voltage for NVIDIA GPU. by @Blacktempel in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2175
* Add sensors for Astral GPUs by @Timic3 in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2168
* Add support for Thermal Grizzly WireView Pro 2. by @Blacktempel in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2171
* Add fan 7 for MSI MEG Z790 GODLIKE MAX by @Blacktempel in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2185
* Add thermal sensor 1 back for NVMe by @Blacktempel in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2186
* Add Pump Fan 2 for MSI MEG Z790 GODLIKE MAX + handle 0 RPM / unplugged fan by @Blacktempel in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2187
* Fix ASUS Z170 EC temperature read returning zero values by @qiku1337 in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2153
* Add support for MSI PRO B850M-A Project Zero by @Alcolawl in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2190
* Fix fan detection for two NCT6687D mainboards by @Blacktempel in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2191
* TG WireView Pro 2: Changes for firmware update by @Blacktempel in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2193
* Add JAF Fan for Godlike Max & fix Pump Fan 2 by @Blacktempel in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2194
* Add support for MSI MAG B850 Tomahawk WIFI by @Alcolawl in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2199
* Add MSI controller for AIOs. by @Blacktempel in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2207
* Slight refactor for ARCTIC Fan Controller by @aureopvh in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2205
* Bump System.Text.Json from 10.0.2 to 10.0.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2214
* Bump System.Threading.AccessControl from 10.0.2 to 10.0.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/pull/2212
* Bump System.IO.Ports from 10.0.2 to 10.0.3 by @dependab

﻿# LibreHardwareMonitor [![GitHub license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor?label=License)](https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/blob/master/LICENSE) [![NuGet](https://img.shields.io/nuget/v/LibreHardwareMonitorLib?label=NuGet&logo=nuget&logoColor=white)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/LibreHardwareMonitorLib/) [![NuGet (Prerelases)](https://img.shields.io/nuget/vpre/LibreHardwareMonitorLib?label=NuGet-Prerelease&logo=nuget&logoColor=white)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/LibreHardwareMonitorLib/) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/nuget/dt/LibreHardwareMonitorLib?label=Downloads&logo=nuget&logoColor=white)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/LibreHardwareMonitorLib/) Libre Hardware Monitor is free software that can monitor the temperature sensors, fan speeds, voltages, load and clock speeds of your computer. ## What's included? | Name| Build Status | | --- | --- | | **LibreHardwareMonitorLib**
Library that allows you to use all features in your own application | [![Build status](https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/actions/workflows/master.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/actions) | | **LibreHardwareMonitor.Windows.Forms**
Windows Forms based application that presents all data in a graphical interface | [![Build status](https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/actions/workflows/master.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/actions) | | **LibreHardwareMonitor.Avalonia**
Avalonia based application that presents all data in a graphical interface
_In development, not recommended yet_ | [![Build status](https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/actions/workflows/master.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/actions) | ## What can it do? You can read information from devices such as: - Motherboards - Intel and AMD processors - NVIDIA, AMD and Intel graphics cards - HDD, SSD and NVMe hard drives - Network cards ## Where can I download it? You can download the latest release [here](https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/releases). ### Nightly builds If you have a **GitHub** account, you can download nightly builds [here](https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/actions). Otherwise, you can download the *latest* nightly build [here (Windows.Forms)](https://nightly.link/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/workflows/master/master/LibreHardwareMonitor.Windows.Forms.zip) or [here (Avalonia)](https://nightly.link/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/workflows/master/master/LibreHardwareMonitor.Avalonia%20%28win-x64%29.zip). ## How can I help improve it? The LibreHardwareMonitor team welcomes feedback and contributions!
You can check if it works properly on your motherboard. For many manufacturers, the way of reading data differs a bit, so if you notice any inaccuracies, please send us a pull request. If you have any suggestions or improvements, don't hesitate to create an issue. ### Which .NET versions are supported? | Target | Library | Windows.Forms | Avalonia | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | .NET Framework 4.7.2 | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | | .NET Framework 4.8.1 | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | | .NET Standard 2.0 | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | | .NET 10 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | .NET 11 | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ## Developer information **Integrate the library in own application** 1. Add the [LibreHardwareMonitorLib](https://www.nuget.org/packages/LibreHardwareMonitorLib/) NuGet package to your application. 2. Use the sample code below. **Sample code** ```c# Computer computer = new Computer { IsCpuEnabled = true, IsGpuEnabled = true, IsMemoryEnabled = true, IsMotherboardEnabled = true, IsControllerEnabled = true, IsNetworkEnabled = true, IsStorageEnabled = true, IsPowerMonitorEnabled = true, }; computer.Open(); computer.Accept(new UpdateVisitor()); foreach (IHardware hardware in computer.Hardware) { Console.WriteLine("Hardware: {0}", hardware.Name); foreach (IHardware subhardware in hardware.SubHardware) { Console.WriteLine("\tSubhardware: {0}", subhardware.Name); foreach (ISensor sensor in subhardware.Sensors) Console.WriteLine("\t\tSensor: {0}, value: {1}", sensor.Name, sensor.Value); } foreach (ISensor sensor in hardware.Sensors) Console.WriteLine("\tSensor: {0}, value: {1}", sensor.Name, sensor.Value); } computer.Close(); public class UpdateVisitor : IVisitor { public void VisitComputer(IComputer computer) => computer.Traverse(this); public void VisitHardware(IHardware hardware) { hardware.Update(); foreach (IHardware subHardware in hardware.SubHardware) subHardware.Accept(this); } public void VisitSensor(ISensor sensor) { } public void VisitParameter(IParameter parameter) { } } ``` **Administrator rights** Some sensors require administrator privileges to access the data. Restart your IDE with admin privileges, or add an [app.manifest](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/sbscs/application-manifests) file to your project with requestedExecutionLevel on requireAdministrator. ## Warning We're **not affiliated** with `librehardwaremonitor.com`.
For your safety, please avoid using that site. ## Acknowledgements Many thanks to all contributors listed below, and to JetBrains for providing tooling. ## License LibreHardwareMonitor is free and open source software licensed under MPL 2.0. Some parts of LibreHardwareMonitor are licensed under different terms, see [THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES](https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/blob/master/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt).
